description: Order an instant or stock server (eq/order_instance). IMPORTANT: ordering charges the credit balance or creates an invoice. Defaults to dry_run=true — only checks preset/OS availability and returns a summary without placing an order. For a real order pass dry_run=false and confirm=true after explicit user consent on the cost. Deploy takes 10–30 minutes; status via check_task.

deploy_notify.description: Email notification when deploy finishes (recommended true)

dry_run.description: Default true: validate parameters without placing an order or charging

hostname.description: Hostname; default is generated from location and ID

preset.description: Preset ID or name from list_presets (e.g. 108 or vm.pico)

root_pass.description: Root password: min. 8 chars, uppercase, digit, special char (not @ or #)

name: order_server
